lineage_warning: This rule is a principled data-semantic continuation of late_volume_clock_compass, which was profitable on 187 complete-window development sessions but failed the two-trades-per-week frequency gate. It is therefore adapted research, not an independent discovery.
objective: Determine whether the relative timing of actual UPRO and SPXU traded volume predicts afternoon direction frequently enough for the $100 cash-only system.
economic_claim: Clock time is not the market's only time. Each ETF has an event-time center of gravity. The fund whose volume mass arrives later during the morning is receiving newer inventory attention; if that inventory is still being transferred at 11:00, its directional exposure should persist into the afternoon.

data_semantics.missing_bar: A missing exchange OHLCV bar means no reported ARCA trade in that minute and contributes zero volume. No price or volume is forward-filled.
data_semantics.eligibility: Each ETF must have positive total observed volume during the window.
data_semantics.volume_clock: For every observed bar, calculate integer minutes since 09:30. The centroid is sum(minute_offset * volume) / sum(volume).
data_semantics.direction: Buy UPRO when score > 0 and SPXU when score < 0. Skip exact ties.

execution.catastrophe_stop: SPY moves 3.333333% adversely from its 11:01 open; trigger on a completed minute and exit at the following ETF bid.
execution.position_type: Long fractional UPRO or long fractional SPXU only
execution.latency: The score aggregates 90 clock minutes, waits one full minute, and must survive additional one-minute and five-minute entry delays.

development_gates.holdout_access: Only if every development gate passes.

secondary_tests: Consolidated-BBO execution audit using the same ARCA-bar signals
One-cent and two-cent adverse execution per share at both fills
prohibited_repairs: Change or invert the score sign.
Require a fitted minimum centroid difference.
Filter weekdays, months, years, direction, volatility, or spread after results.
Turn score-magnitude diagnostics into a rule without a new preregistration.
